scripts.dev: lsof -ti:3000 | xargs kill -9 2>/dev/null || true; NODE_OPTIONS='--max-http-header-size=131072' next dev -p 3000
scripts.dev:clean: lsof -ti:3000 | xargs kill -9 2>/dev/null || true; rm -rf .next && NODE_OPTIONS='--max-http-header-size=131072' next dev -p 3000
scripts.check:health: node -e "fetch('http://localhost:3000').then(r => console.log('Pulse Health Status:', r.status)).catch(e => console.error('Health Check Error:', e.message))"
scripts.start: lsof -ti:3000 | xargs kill -9 2>/dev/null || true; NODE_OPTIONS='--max-http-header-size=131072' next start -p 3000
